about: ADR 0855 D1 merge gate: a seeded SDLC/launch scenario. Each case is a ledger (with its recorded decisions) and what a run produced. `expect: flag` = the work departs from the ledger with NO recorded decision covering it (must yield >= 1 unexplained finding); `expect: pass` = the work follows the ledger, or departs only where a recorded decision covers it (must yield 0 unexplained). Bar: >= 0.9 of `flag` cases flagged AND <= 0.1 of `pass` cases falsely flagged (scripts/eval-drift-check.mts).
